  from the version-pinned package, not replaced by standalone components.
  Notice: `notices/STROKE_DATA_ARPHICPL.txt`.
- BabelStone IDS, 2025-06-27 / Unicode 16.0: source comparisons retain their

  font artwork, table artwork or complete standard component inventory is
  redistributed. Source: https://www.unicode.org/irg/docs/n2739-GF0014-2009.pdf

coverage do not establish editorial approval, etymology or verified stroke names.

entries.text: As per 旨# (sweet/rich food) + 肉 flesh → rich *fat* → *grease*; *resin*.
戴角者脂，無角者膏。从肉旨聲。
小耎易斷也。从肉，从絕省。

As per 劦# as described in 協 (pressure from two sides) + 肉 flesh → the two sides of the body, under pressure → *threaten* (← be threatened by attackers at both sides; compare 狹) → *frighten*; *fear*; *be scared*; *startle*.
兩𦜶也。从肉劦聲。

Originally 脃, which is as per the obsolete right-hand element# described in 絶 (cut into pieces) + 肉 flesh → severed body parts → *fragile*; *brittle* (← easily broken) → *susceptible*; *sentimental*. 脆 replaces this right-hand element with 危. Note that some sources give 脃 as an independent character with the meaning "gland."
Effectively a variant form of 脅# (one's side), with the 肉 flesh element repositioned, and emphasizing the physical points the *armpits* and the *sides/flanks* → *side*. Compare 胳 and 亦.
As per 𠂢# as described in 派 (rivulets) + 肉 flesh → *vein*; *blood vessel* (← rivulets concealed in the body) → *pulse* → (faint) *hope* (← faint sensation of a pulse).

The relevant seal inscription form combines 肉 flesh with a representation# of a jagged *backbone* (compare 呂) → *back*; (a person's) *height*. Also, *ridge* (elevated in the middle, and depressed on the sides).
背呂也。从𠦬从肉。

entries.text: 胃府也。从肉完聲。讀若患。舊云脯。
齊人謂臞脙也。从肉求聲。讀若休止。
却# withdraw + 肉 flesh → *leg* (← body part allowing one to withdraw).
As per 巠# as described in 徑 (extensive) + 肉 flesh → the *shin* (← portion of the leg extending from knee to ankle) → *leg*.
胻也。从肉坙聲。
面和也。从𦣻从肉。讀若柔。
脅肉也。从肉寽聲。一曰脟，腸閒𦘺也。一曰膫也。
生肉醬也。从肉延聲。
背肉也。从肉𣫭聲。《易》曰：“咸其脢。”
口耑也。从肉辰聲。
赤子陰也。从肉夋聲。或从血。
As per 攸# (slender and curved) + 肉 flesh → slender, curved strips of *dried meat*.
脯也。从肉攸聲。
創肉反出也。从肉希聲。
消肉臞也。从肉兌聲。
𦜶光也。从肉孚聲。
As per 甫# (spread) + 肉 flesh → a lump of *dried meat*. Compare 焙.
乾肉也。从肉甫聲。
項也。从肉豆聲。
As per 兌# (strip away) + 肉 flesh → strip away meat from bone → *take/strip off* → *undress*; *come off*; *omit*; *escape*.
長# long + 肉 flesh → swollen/bloated flesh → *swelling*. Compare 膨.
膎肉也。从肉兩聲。
𡱂也。从肉隹聲。
As per 卑# (spread low) + 肉 flesh → *spleen* (← internal organ associated with the flat/low earth).
土藏也。从肉卑聲。
瘢胝也。从肉垂聲。
As per 典# (weigh upon heavily) + 肉 flesh → abundant flesh/meat → *abundant*. Also, *great consideration* (← magnanimity born of abundance).
設膳腆腆多也。从肉典聲。
As per 昔# (pile) + 肉 flesh → piles of dried/preserved meat at *year-end sacrificial rites* (compare 臘) → *dried meat*.
夜 here a variant form# of 亦 (the armpits) + 肉 flesh (for emphasis/clarification) → *armpits* → *the sides of the body*.
漬肉也。从肉奄聲。
As per 臤# (adhere) + 肉 flesh → the testes, which adhere to the scrotum. *Kidney/the kidneys* is a borrowed meaning.
水藏也。从肉臤聲。
挑取骨閒肉也。从肉叕聲。讀若《詩》曰“啜其泣矣”。
As per 府# (storehouse) + 肉 flesh → stored meat that has spoiled → *spoil*; *rot*; *decompose*; *decay*; *go bad*; *corrode*; *corrupt*.
爛也。从肉府聲。
As per 府# (set in place) + 肉 flesh → *internal organs* set in their positions throughout the body → *intestines*; *entrails*.
北方謂鳥腊曰腒。从肉居聲。傳曰：堯如腊，舜如腒。
As per 非# (spread in alignment to right and left) + 肉 flesh → the *calf* (← composed of a pair of muscles).
脛腨也。从肉非聲。
As per 空# (emptiness) + 肉 flesh → *body cavities*, including the *chest cavity*.
内空也。从肉从空，空亦聲。
宛# bend + 肉 flesh → (flexible) *wrist* → *arm* → *talent*; *ability* (← accomplishments ← things accomplished with the hands/arms). For wrist and arm, compare 捥.
婦始孕腜兆也。从肉某聲。
有骨醢也。从肉耎聲。
As per 奏# (skinned) + 肉 flesh → the hypodermis (skin layer between the epidermis and bone/muscle) → *skin*.
As per 星# (invigorating) + 肉 flesh → the pungent, invigorating *smell of raw meat* → *rank odor* → *fishy*.
星見食豕，令肉中生小息肉也。从肉从星，星亦聲。
As per 𡿺# as described in 惱 (brain) + 肉 flesh (for emphasis/clarification) → brains → *brain* → *head*; *main*.
腓腸也。从肉耑聲。
As per 重# (run through) + 肉 flesh → *swelling*; *swell*; *tumor* (← swellings, tumors etc. running all through the body).
癰也。从肉重聲。
嘉善肉也。从肉柔聲。
牛羊曰𦘺，豕曰腯。从肉盾聲。
要# waist/hips + 肉 flesh → *waist*; *hips*; *small of the back*. 腰 was devised to replace 要 after the latter acquired its extended meanings.
建# erect + 肉 flesh → *tendon* (allowing muscles to extend and/or raise bones).
脛也。从肉卻聲。
As per 臾# (bulging) + 肉 flesh → *bulging stomach* → *fat*; *rich soil*.
腹下𦘺也。从肉臾聲。
昜# rise + 肉 flesh → gas rising in the *intestines*.
大小腸也。从肉昜聲。

复 is an abbreviated form of 畐 as described in 副 (alcohol container with a bulging middle) + 夂 leg/foot pointed downward (→ action indicator) → send back/return something received (in kind) → double back. 腹 is as per 复# (double back) + 肉 flesh → *stomach* of an obese person (i.e. with an extra layer of fat doubled atop the abdominal muscles) → *abdomen*; *belly*.
厚也。从肉复聲。
泉 spring + 肉 flesh → fluid-secreting organs of an animal or human → *glands*.
As per 退# (drop) + 肉 flesh → drop into a squat (compare 蹲 and 崔), the body supported by the thighs → *thigh*.
As per 旁# (spread to/be on both sides) + 肉 flesh → the *shoulder blades* (one on each side of the body) → *upper arm*. *The sides of the body* is via a Japanese reinterpretation of the elements.
脅也。从肉㫄聲。
As per 旅# (run in a line) + 肉 flesh → *spine*; *backbone* (← bones running in a line; compare 呂).
As per 鬲# (partition) + 肉 flesh → *diaphragm* partitioning the abdomen and chest.
As per 尃# as described in 博 (spread) + 肉 flesh → arm (← part of the body that spreads in various directions) → *upper arm* → *shoulder*.
薄脯，膊之屋上。从肉尃聲。
瘦也。从肉𦟝聲。
牛百葉也。从肉𣬉聲。一曰鳥膍胵。
脯也。从肉奚聲。
高 here an abbreviated form# of 皜 pure white + 肉 flesh → white fat → *tasty food*; *fat* → *grease* → *ointment*; *paste* (n.) (← greasy substance).
𦘺也。从肉高聲。
As per 國# (enclosure) + 肉 flesh → the hollow in which the knee is enclosed → *hollow/back of the knee*.
牛脅後髀前合革肉也。从肉𤐫聲。讀若繇。
An abbreviated form# of 虜 (emaciated) + 肉 flesh → (emaciated) *skin*.
As per 莫# (concealed) + 肉 flesh → *membrane* (← fleshy element that conceals).
肉閒胲膜也。从肉莫聲。
As per 桼# as described in 漆 (cut at intervals) + 肉 flesh → the *knee*, a joint that cuts the leg into two sections (compare 節) → *lap* (formed when sitting with the knees together).
切肉也。从肉專聲。

As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 肉 flesh → *sticky* substance produced by separating the non-edible portions of a bird from the edible ones and boiling the former down (compare 餃) → *stick to*; *glue*.
昵也。作之以皮。从肉翏聲。
楚俗以二月祭飲食也。从肉婁聲。一曰祈穀食新曰離膢。
As per 窒# (stopping point) + 肉 flesh → reach the upper stopping point of a *vagina* in copulation.
As per 彭# (surge/swell) + 肉 flesh → swelling flesh → *swell*; *bulge*; *bloat*; *fill*. Compare 脹.
As per 貳# as described in 弐 (aligned) + 肉 flesh → aligned slabs of *viscous grease/fat* → *fat*; *fatty*.
上𦘺也。从肉貳聲。
牛腸脂也。从肉尞聲。《詩》曰：“取其血膫。”
耎易破也。从肉毳聲。
豕肉羹也。从肉堯聲。
As per 番# (spread) + 肉 flesh → *ritual offering of cooked meat* (← a spread of meat).
善# good + 肉 flesh → high-quality meat → meals; provisions. Low *serving table* and *tray* are borrowed meanings.
具食也。从肉善聲。
As per 無# (concealed) + 肉 flesh → *thin strips of dried meat* (easily concealed when carried as a provision). Later, the character also acquired the meaning of a *thick chunk of (dried) meat*.
無骨腊也。楊雄說：鳥腊也。从肉無聲。《周禮》有膴判。讀若謨。
As per 萃 (unify) + 肉 flesh → *pancreas* (← pan- = "all; unity" + -creas = "flesh").
𦞦也。从肉賁聲。
As per 亶# (long and flat) + 肉 flesh → (in Chinese medicine) the flat *center of the chest* between the breasts. *Strip* (off clothes) is a borrowed meaning, via 襢.
肉膻也。从肉亶聲。《詩》曰：“膻裼暴虎。”
As per 詹# (bear a burden) + 肉 flesh → gallstones burdening a *gallbladder* → *courage* (← courage welling from deep within; compare English "guts") → *pluck*; *nerve*. Compare 肝 and 腹.
連肝之府。从肉詹聲。

As per 會# (reduce/eliminate space) + 肉 flesh → thin slices of raw meat/fish covering a platter → *namasu* (sliced vegetables and fish in a vinegar dressing). A variant form, 鱠, replaces 肉 with 魚 fish.
細切肉也。从肉會聲。
As per 農# (soft and sticky) + 肉 flesh → sticky *pus* oozing from sores → *suppurate*; *fester*.
As per 殿# (buttocks) + 肉 flesh → *buttocks* → *rear/tail end*; *bottom*. 臀 was devised to replace 殿 after the latter acquired its extended meanings.
As per 辟# (spread) + 肉 flesh → the spreading flesh of the *arm*. *Elbow* is a borrowed meaning.
手上也。从肉辟聲。
As per 意# (contained in the heart) + 肉 flesh → *heart*; *chest*; *breast* (← physical seat of the heart, regarded as the source of *thought*). *Timidity* is a borrowed meaning.
𦞦也。从肉雋聲。讀若纂。
As per 僉# (assemble) + 肉 flesh → assemble shredded meat on a platter. The *area between the eyes and cheekbones* and *the face* are borrowed meanings.
豕膏臭也。从肉喿聲。
As per 齊# (align) + 肉 flesh → the *navel*, neatly aligned in the middle of the body (compare 毘).
As per 賓# (contact) + 肉 flesh → *kneecap* (in contact with the knee). Effectively a variant form of 髕.
As per 需# (soft) + 肉 flesh → *soft meat*. (The fleshy) *upper arm* is a borrowed meaning. In Japan, 臑 has also been taken to refer to the *leg* or *shin*.
臂羊矢也。从肉需聲。讀若襦。
As per 巤# as described in 獵 (capture and bind) + 肉 flesh → *year-end rite* involving sacrifices of captive, bound animals (compare 腊) → *the end of the year*; *12th lunar month*.
冬至後三戌，臘祭百神。从肉巤聲。
燕# swallow + 肉 flesh → *rouge* (the lustrous color of a swallow's feathers). *Throat* is a borrowed meaning, either directly via 咽 (throat) or indirectly via 嚥 swallow (→ throat).
As per 盧# (cooking pot → shape indicator) + 肉 flesh → *distended belly*. *Align* and *transmit* (from superior to subordinate) are borrowed meanings.
皮也。从肉盧聲。
少肉也。从肉瞿聲。
As per 藏# (pile) + 肉 flesh → the body's vital organs, conceived of as being piled one atop the other → *organ*.
䜌 as described in 戀, here an abbreviated form# of 巒 mountain range + 肉 flesh → heaping mound of sliced or *chopped meat* → *slice of meat*.

The relevant oracle bone form of this character is a variant form of 見 (person whose sight is fixed upon an object he is being shown), the person here being understood as a *subject* or *retainer* → *retain* (a person); *serve* (as a retainer). As an independent character, 臣 is regarded as consisting of seven strokes, but some sources enumerate it as six when it appears as an element in a derivative character (compare the treatment of stroke counts in 此).
牽也。事君也。象屈服之形。凡臣之屬皆从臣。
As per 臣# (fix upon) + 又 hand/action indicator → (cause to) adhere. *Hard* and *wise* are borrowed meanings.
堅也。从又臣聲。凡臤之屬皆从臤。讀若鏗鏘之鏗。古文以爲賢字。
As per 臣# (fix upon) + 人 person (→ human agency) → *lie face down* (fixing the body to the ground/bedding below) → *sleep*.
休也。从人、臣，取其伏也。凡臥之屬皆从臥。
乖也。从二臣相違。讀若誑。
As per 戕# (long and slender) + 臣 retainer → tall retainer → (male) *servant*; *good* (← skilled servant).
善也。从臣戕聲。
An abbreviated form# of 監 keep watch over + 品 assorted goods → keep watch over assorted people/objects (compare 督) → *survey*; *command* → *face* (an object/situation).
監臨也。从臥品聲。
驚走也。一曰往來也。从夰、臦。《周書》曰：“伯臩。”古文臦，古文囧字。

A depiction of a nose. Conceptually, the character suggests slender streams of breath passing through the nostrils (compare 四) of a stumpy nose. *Self* is an extended meaning (← point toward one's nose to indicate self) → *by/for oneself*; *originally*; *from*.
鼻也。象鼻形。凡自之屬皆从自。
自# (stumpy) nose + 木 tree/wood → a (tree) *stump* or *stake* (= a stumpy piece of wood) serving as a *landmark*. *Gatepost* is a borrowed meaning, via 闑.
射凖的也。从木从自。李陽冰曰：“自非聲，从劓省。”

Originally 犬 here an abbreviated form# of 犾 as described in 獄 (pair of dogs) + 自 (nose) → dogs sniffing each other → (foul) *smell* → *reek*; *stench*. 臭 is a variant form dropping one stroke from the 犬 element, the original form remaining in derivative characters such as 嗅 and 糗.
禽走，臭而知其迹者，犬也。从犬从自。
眾詞與也。从乑自聲。《虞書》曰：“臮咎繇。”

The relevant oracle bone form of this character depicts 矢# arrow arriving at a target, its *stopping point* → *arrive*; *reach*; *lead to*; *proceed*; *come*; *extend to* → *come to do*; *bring about*; *result in*. In derivative characters such as 疾, 耋, 銍 and 絰, 至 suggests specifically the stopping point of a life.
鳥飛从高下至地也。从一，一猶地也。象形。不，上去；而至，下來也。凡至之屬皆从至。

Originally 至# arrive + 夂 leg/foot pointed downward (here an action indicator) → *cause* to arrive, actually or figuratively (= occur) → *bring about*; *do*; *exert oneself*. The present form replaces 夂 with 攵 action indicator.
送詣也。从夊从至。

緻.explanation: 緻 is used for fine, delicate or intricate texture; 致 remains for cause, send, or convey.
緻.example: 精致 → 精緻; 致谢 → 致謝

entries.text: 至# arrow (doubled) → arrows.
到也。从二至。
至# (arrow) + an abbreviated form of 高 tall/high → raise a tall *platform* from which to shoot arrows → *pedestal*.
觀，四方而高者。从至从之，从高省。與室屋同意。

entries.text: As per 秦# (make fine) + 至 proceed; arrive → proceed with fine steps, then *reach/arrive* at one's destination (compare 贊).
至也。从至秦聲。

A depiction of a rounded *mortar* → *mortar-shaped object* → *bone socket*. In derivative characters such as 舊/旧 and 舅, 臼 lends the conceptual influence "stooped," the habitual posture used in working a mortar/pestle set in ancient times.
舂也。古者掘地爲臼，其後穿木石。象形。中，米也。凡臼之屬皆从臼。
臼 here a variant form of 函# place inside + 人 person → person contained/concealed within a *hole/cavity/pit* (compare 禍, 陷, 俗 and 凶).
小阱也。从人在臼上。
A depiction of a bulging object held in a pair of hands. The compound 須臾 refers to a brief moment → a short while.

臼 mortar + a slender chisel (not 干 forked stick or thick bar) → slender, chisel-like stick pressed/inserted into a mortar in separating grain from husk → *insert*; *break into*; *separate grain from husk*.
舂去麥皮也。从臼，干所以臿之。
